EX-99.1 2 ea031044001ex99-1.htm PRESS RELEASE Exhibit 99.1 Enlivex Announces Favorable 12-Month Topline Data from Phase I/IIa Allocetra Trial, Demonstrating Durable Treatment Response ● In patients aged 64+: 79.2% of patients achieved a clinically meaningful response (reduced pain and improved knee function) in the Allocetra™ group vs. 47.6% in the placebo group at 12 months (p=0.027) 1 ● Allocetra™ treatment benefit at 12 months was consistent with the response rates observed at 3 and 6 months, demonstrating a durable effect from a single treatment cycle ● The 12-month data will be presented at the American College of Rheumatology (ACR) Convergence in a poster presentation on November 8, 2026 Nes-Ziona, Israel, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Enlivex Ltd.

(Nasdaq: ENLV) (“Enlivex” or the “Company”), a quality longevity company powered by a prediction markets treasury, today announced favorable 12-month topline data from the randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase IIa stage of the Company’s multi-country Phase I/IIa trial (ENX-CL-05-001) evaluating Allocetra™ in patients with moderate to severe knee osteoarthritis.

Summary of the 12-month Topline Data, Age Group 64+ ● Sustained responder benefit at one year: The proportion of patients (age 64+) achieving a clinically meaningful response 2 (reduced pain and increased knee function) was 66% higher for the Allocetra™ group than for the placebo group at 12 months, consistent with the treatment benefit observed at the earlier 3- and 6-month timepoints: o At 12 months: 79.2% responders in the Allocetra™ group vs. 47.6% in the placebo group (p=0.027) o This substantial treatment benefit was consistent with the response rates observed at 3 months (80% higher for the Allocetra™ group than for the placebo group; p=0.019) and 6 months (39% higher for the Allocetra™ group than for the placebo group; p=0.168). ● Improvement in pain and function maintained through 12 months: Allocetra™ produced statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements versus placebo at 3 and 6 months.

Adverse events were predominantly transient, mild to moderate local knee reactions, consistent with previously reported data. 1 Summary of the 12-month Topline Data, Age Group 64+ 2 Under the OMERACT-OARSI responder criteria, the established standard for osteoarthritis trials 3 WOMAC: a widely used, standardized questionnaire to evaluate the condition and quality of life of patients with osteoarthritis of the hip and knee 12-month data presentation at the ACR convergence ACR Convergence 2026 is taking place November 6–11, 2026 at the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando, Florida.
